Ex:ng++ -O0 -g3 -Wall -c -fmessage-length=0 -MMD -MP -MF"fooo.d" -MT"fooo.d" -o"fooo.o" "C:/eclipse3.2/eclipse/test/fooo.cpp" When using the internal builder, a relative path is used in the build process. This relative path always assumes that the base in the project directory. Ex: (Same as above, but switched to Internal Builder)ng++ -O0 -g3 -Wall -c -fmessage-length=0 -ofooo.o ..\fooo.cpp
